title: Disclosure profiles
description: What a shared copy may reveal (spec FR-045). Redaction DELETES the listed fields from the data document itself, not from the display (FR-047) — a page that merely hides a figure still ships it. A profile is rejected before anything is produced if a withheld figure remains derivable from what it retains (FR-049).

profiles.description: Keyed by profile name. MUST include 'full' and 'figures-hidden' (FR-046).

derivations.description: The reconstruction paths the derivability check knows about (research R-010). Adding a derived figure to the document REQUIRES adding its rule here, otherwise the check silently under-reports.

from.description: Field paths which, if ALL retained, reconstruct the target.

withhold.description: Document field paths to delete, e.g. 'positions[].lots[].qty'. Empty for the 'full' profile.

note.description: Stated on the shared copy so a recipient knows what was withheld (FR-048).

requires_confirmation.description: MUST be true for any profile withholding nothing — producing a full-disclosure copy requires an explicit confirmation naming what is about to leave the machine (FR-050).
